reading.action: One final smithing push: consolidate all his fully-charged ember metal + his own core into a single heaviest, most ember-infused double-ended weapon — Burning Anger split, haft fused with the ember rod into a shaft, the Furnace-heart cored and clad with the rivet/brazier-stand/old head, that head welded to one end and the hammer-head to the other; focus paced to empty; then admire and meditate to recover.

check.note: NAT 20 / CRIT, transcendent. The finest thing he has made: flawless white-hot welds (powered by pooled battery-charge, not his solo ceiling), a living Furnace-heart core, perfect balance, total ember saturation. Both forging skills demonstrated at rung-top on one masterwork capstone.

reading.ruling_locked: t65 WHITE-HOT FORGE-WELD: his solo affinity-7 heat ceiling is yellow-hot (t47), but POOLING the banked charge of massed fully-charged ember batteries THROUGH the work drives WHITE-HOT welds — the batteries pay the extra heat. Extends t63 battery-pays-the-heat / forge-bind to forge-WELDING. Not a new solo cap; requires massed charged sources.

gain.note: Crit capstone demo; both skills were at rung-top with qualifying demos (masterwork forge for Smithing; stable battery-cored bind for Essence Infusion).

reading.result: CAPSTONE FORGE — masterwork. NAT-20 crit consolidated all six ember pieces + his own core into one artifact-tier double-ended weapon (Furnace-heart living core, flawless white-hot welds, perfect balance, total ember saturation; his finest conduit — the core feeds flame-techniques from its own banked charge). atk 6 -> 10. SMITHING PROMOTED Novice 3 -> Apprentice 1; ESSENCE INFUSION PROMOTED Apprentice 5 -> Journeyman 1. No affinity tick (expenditure). Consumed: Burning Anger, Ember-bound iron rod, Furnace-heart, fire-purged rivet, brazier-stand, iron hammer-head. Kept: River-stone (cold), Stalker hide + eye-lens. Focus paced to empty, then meditation restored all pools to MAX (hp 124, focus 114, stamina 76; no HP loss). Weapon UNNAMED (his to name), retains a large banked charge. STOP admiring + rested, masterwork in hand — NOT yet climbing. NO assumed climb. NO Tower reset.
